item.text: {"role":"structure","inspection_scope":"Complete supplied film plan, including script, rhetorical chapter, setup contracts, beat contracts, semantic centers, dominant actions, before/after states, resets, composition plans, and continuity-token lifecycle.","checks":[{"check":"METAPHOR_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"The film uses two bounded rules: s1 physically inspects the sample under a lens, then s2 compares it with an intact reference on a separate rail. The inspection apparatus does not travel into the comparison setup."},{"check":"STATE_ACCUMULATION_WITHOUT_MEANING","status":"PASS","evidence":"s1 ends after exposing the gap, and its lens and old set are explicitly absent in s2. Only the story-relevant sample persists."},{"check":"SEMANTIC_GROUP_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"s1 centers the sample-lens interaction; s2 centers the aligned sample/reference pair. Each setup has one coherent dominant group rather than unrelated competing groups."},{"check":"COMPOSITIONAL_STAGNATION","status":"PASS","evidence":"The planned reset changes the dominant arrangement and scale: s1 uses a large sample and lens with Bot at right, while s2 uses paired samples in a detail crop with Bot below and a different silhouette and camera scale."},{"check":"CONTINUITY_TOKEN_OVERLOAD","status":"PASS","evidence":"Only the sample crosses the cut. Its identity, origin, state changes, ordered use, final destination, and narrative justification are recorded, while the lens and inspection set remain behind."},{"check":"CLUTTER_WITHOUT_PURPOSE","status":"PASS","evidence":"The plans specify only functional location, depth, balance, and action elements: paper backboard, work surface, contact plane, sample, lens or comparison rail/reference, and a corner crop directing attention to contact."},{"check":"WEAK_RESET_RHYTHM","status":"PASS","evidence":"The shift from inspection to comparison receives a hard cut, a new rail, a changed palette family, a changed composition and camera scale, and removal of the old inspection apparatus."},{"check":"COMPETING_FOCI","status":"PASS","evidence":"Each beat identifies one dominant action and focal sample: opening it beneath the lens in s1, then sliding and aligning it beside the reference in s2. No unrelated active secondary region is planned."},{"check":"CAPTION_CARRIES_STORY","status":"PASS","evidence":"The central actions encode the narrated meanings without captions: the lens visibly exposes a route gap, and alignment beside an intact reference visibly demonstrates what is missing."}],"setup_assessments":[{"setup_id":"s1","status":"PASS","evidence":"A single inspection rule governs the setup: the folded sample enters, is opened beneath a lens, and exits with its gap exposed. The planned dominant region, action, and state change agree."},{"setup_id":"s2","status":"PASS","evidence":"A distinct comparison rule governs the setup: the same identifiable sample enters a new rail without the old apparatus, aligns beside an intact reference, and ends with the missing route visibly demonstrated."}],"violations":[],"limits":"This data-only review assesses planned structure and hierarchy. It cannot establish rendered legibility, pixel visibility, actual mobile-glance performance, animation execution, timing quality, or listening/audio performance."}
